title: Trend Micro OfficeScan Named Pipe Request Processing Out-Of-Bounds Read Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to disclose sensitive information on vulnerable installations of Trend Micro OfficeScan. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of data from a named pipe in Ntrtscan.exe. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to escalate privileges to SYSTEM.
